The '''1963–64 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 28th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece.  The season began on 14 September 1963 and ended on 14 June 1964 with the relegation play-off match. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their seventh Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
